nodes.name: Electrochemical phase reconstruction
nodes.procedure: NiSe nanorods (NS) uniformly anchored on nickel foam (NF) as working electrode underwent cyclic voltammetry (CV) activation in KOH electrolyte over the redox potential range (1.1 to 1.6 V_RHE) at 5 mV/s scan rate. After 30 CV cycles, partial surface reconstruction occurred where crystalline NiOOH epitaxially grew on NS surface forming hydrangea-like NS/NOOH-30 heterojunction with lattice mismatch-induced interfacial stress.
nodes.source_text: Typically, cyclic voltammetry (CV) activation was performed over the entire redox potential range (1.1 to 1.6 V_RHE using NS as an operating electrode... After 30 cycles, the final product NS/NOOH electrode exhibits...

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD spectra of NS well matched the characteristic peaks of NiSe (JCPDS NO 89-2058). NS/NOOH-1 shows no significant change from NS. NS/NOOH-30 shows new diffraction peaks at 2θ of 18.4°, 37.3° and 66.8° indexed as (001), (002) and (110) planes of NiOOH (JCPDS NO 06-0141), with (110) plane of NiSe shifting to smaller angle (d-spacing from 5.0035 Å to 5.103 Å) and (001) plane of NiOOH shifting to larger angle (d-spacing from 4.83 Å to 4.755 Å).
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD spectra (Fig. S1 ) well matched the characteristic peaks of NiSe (JCPDS NO 89-2058), proving the successful preparation of the NS catalyst... As shown in Fig. 2a, no significant change was observed in the XRD patterns of NS/NOOH-1 compared with that of NS... In contrast, three new diffraction peaks appearing at 2θ of approximately 18.4, 37.3 and 66.8 can be clearly observed, which can be clearly identified and indexed as the characteristic peaks of (001), (002) and (110) planes of the 2D brucite type hexagonal layered structure...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p spectrum of NS/NOOH-1 shows new peaks at 856.88 and 874.58 eV for Ni3+. NS/NOOH-30 shows enhanced Ni3+ peaks with increased Ni3+/Ni2+ ratio and 0.3 eV low-energy shift. Se 3d peaks decrease with increased SeOx and 0.25 eV high-energy shift in NS/NOOH-30. O 1s shows increased O–H and adsorbed H2O peaks in NS/NOOH-30.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 3a, compared with the fresh NS, the Ni 2p spectrum of NS/NOOH-1 shows new convolution peaks at 856.88 and 874.58 eV corresponding to high-valence Ni3+... Aer 30 CV cycles, the convolution peaks corresponding to Ni3+ ions on the NS/NOOH-30 electrode surface were significantly enhanced... the Ni 2p spectra of NS/NOOH-30 samples show an obvious low-energy shi of about 0.3 eV, and the Se 3d spectra show a high-energy shi of about 0.25 eV...

nodes.characterization_summary: NS shows nanorod array morphology. NS/NOOH-30 shows nano-flower morphology composed of interconnected curly nanosheets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As revealed by SEM images (Fig. 1f), the nano-flower composed of many interconnected curly nanosheets grows from the center radially and distributes in the shape of irregular microspheres...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms transformation from NS nanorods to NS/NOOH-30 nano-flower structure. HRTEM shows lattice spacing of NiSe (021) plane increased from 2.64 Å to 2.677 Å and NiOOH (001) plane decreased from 0.311 Å to 0.42 Å. SAED shows polycrystalline nature with diffraction rings for NS (211) and NiOOH (110) planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The low-magniﬁcation TEM images of NS (Fig. 1d) and NS/NOOH-30 (Fig. 1g) further demonstrated the transformation of nanorods into this unique nanoﬂower structure... Notably, the SAED pattern of the electrochemically reconstructed NS/NOOH-30 shows bright circular diffraction rings... HRTEM images and corresponding FFT images... show that the lattice spacing of the (021) plane attributed to NiSe increases from 2.64 Å to 2.677 Å...
